scenarios.behaviour: Listing catalog items returns the first page, page index 0, with a total count and each item's id, name and price.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'returns paginated items with correct shape'

scenarios.behaviour: Listing items filtered by name returns only items whose name starts with it.
Listing items with a page size returns at most that many items.
Listing items filtered by type ids returns only items of those types.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'filters by type ids and returns only matching items'

scenarios.behaviour: Listing items filtered by name, type and brand together returns a well-formed first page.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'filters by name and type and brand combined'. The test checks the page's shape only, not that each item matches all three filters.

scenarios.behaviour: Getting items by a list of ids returns exactly the items with those ids.
Getting items by an empty list of ids returns an empty list.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'getItemsByIds with empty array returns empty list'

scenarios.behaviour: Getting an item by id returns that item with its name and price.
Getting an item with an id of 0 or less returns 400.
Getting an item that doesn't exist returns 404.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog-contract.api.spec.ts 'GET /items/{id} for a missing item returns the documented 404'

scenarios.behaviour: Listing catalog types returns every type with its id and name.
Listing catalog brands returns every brand with its id and name.
Creating an item stores it under a new positive id with the name and price it was given.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'createItem returns a positive integer id', 'created item is fetchable by id'

scenarios.behaviour: Creating an item without a name returns 400.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog-contract.api.spec.ts 'POST /items without a name returns the documented 400'. Known eShop bug: returns an undocumented 500.

scenarios.behaviour: Updating an item's price changes the price the item is fetched with afterwards.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog.api.spec.ts 'updateItem changes a field on the item'

scenarios.behaviour: Deleting an item removes it, so getting it afterwards returns 404.
Deleting an item that doesn't exist returns 404.
scenarios.sourceNote: tests/api/catalog-contract.api.spec.ts 'DELETE /items/{id} for a missing item returns the documented 404'. 'deleteItem on non-existent id throws' in catalog.api.spec.ts checks only that it fails, so it does not claim this row.

scenarios.behaviour: Opening the home page shows the catalog under the heading 'Ready for a new adventure?'.
Opening an existing item's page shows the item's product image.
